name: HubSpot Engagement Intelligence — Nightly Scorer v1.0

parameters.content:
### ⏰ NIGHTLY ENGAGEMENT SCORER v1.0

**What this does:**
Runs every night at 2am. Reads real HubSpot email
engagement data from every contact, calculates an
engagement score and status, and writes the results
back to your canonical fields.

After this runs, /engagement-check reports on real
data — no seed script needed for production.

**Canonical fields written per contact:**
• canon_engagement_score            (0-100)
• canon_engagement_status           (Active/At Risk/Cold/Dormant/Opted Out)
• canon_days_since_engagement       (integer)
• canon_engagement_last_calculated  (timestamp)

**Scoring uses these READ-ONLY HubSpot fields:**
• hs_email_sends_since_last_engagement  ← primary decay signal
• hs_email_open                         ← historical depth bonus
• hs_email_click                        ← historical depth bonus
• hs_email_optout                       ← hard penalty
• hs_email_last_open_date               ← recency signal
• hs_email_last_click_date              ← recency signal

**Post-import wiring check (n8n import quirk):**
⚠ Verify SplitInBatches connections after import:
  loop output → Get Contact Full Data
  done output → Log Run Complete

**Schedule:** Daily at 2:00am
Adjust in the Schedule Trigger node if needed.
